crosscheck.explanation: Revenue is identical under both delivery strategies (the same arrivals are served) and waiting cost is linear in total flow time, so d(profit) = -(waiting cost rate) * d(total flow time). The two break-even loads must therefore coincide; a gap of one bisection tolerance is numerical, not economic.
